title: Skip the CI disk cleanup when the runner already has room
body:
## Why

Every CI job that needs the CI image starts with `./.github/actions/prepare_breeze_and_image`, and its second step removes the runner's pre-installed dotnet, Android SDK and tool cache before the image is even downloaded. 

#73477 added a `min-free-space-gb` threshold there, but it defaults to empty, which means always remove, and only the docs build passes a value. An `ubuntu-22.04` runner starts with 86 GiB free and the heaviest job using this action peaks at 24 GiB, so each job spends a median of 2 minutes freeing 29 GiB that nothing uses.

## What

Set the default to 60 GiB and drop the explicit 40 the docs build passed. 60 only has to sit above 24 and below 86, so 40 works too and I am happy to change it.

| run | runner time freed
| --- | ---: | 
| full matrix (149 jobs) | 132 min 
| normal pull request (78 jobs) | 36 min 

Measured over 40 runs of `ci-amd.yml`.

related: #73477
